sentences.en: Instantly the girl saw her mother, she burst out crying.
sentences.zh: 女孩一看到妈妈立刻哭了起来。

sentences.en: The whole class burst into laughter at the teacher's joke.
sentences.zh: 老师开完玩笑后，全班哄堂大笑。

sentences.en: The buds burst open at the first sign of spring.
sentences.zh: 春意一现，花蕾便绽开了。
